title: Sher Shah Suri Contribution Coinage
definition: Sher Shah Suri (1540-1545) revolutionized the Indian monetary system by abolishing debased currency and introducing a standardized tri-metallic currency system based on fixed weights and purity.
importanceInUpsc: This topic is a perennial favorite in UPSC Prelims (History) due to its role in economic integration, administrative centralization, and its direct influence on the Mughal and British currency systems.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Sher Shah Suri Contribution Coinage.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic knowledge of Mughal economic administration
